# syq 0.10.1

This release clarifies help text and the documentation. It changes no copy
behavior.

## Highlights

- Help text and messages call the separate set of connections and settings
  that `syq persist on --ephemeral` creates and `--pscope` selects a *scope*.
- The Copy files guide now lives at
  [copy-files.html](https://greaber.github.io/syq/copy-files.html). The old
  `reference.html` address is not redirected.
- The documentation was audited end to end: errors fixed, reference details
  moved out of the guides, and repeated caveats consolidated.

## Compatibility

As with every release, install the same version on every machine; machines
running different syq versions refuse to work together.
